summary: shemnon 提交两项后量子相关 EIP：EIP-7819 允许在委托标识后附加尾随数据，并给出把 ML-DSA 公钥存入尾随数据、由 EIP-8141 代码接受的示例；新 EIP-8355 为 FIPS 204 ML-DSA 三个安全级别提供验证预编译。donnoh 提交 EIP-8357 EVM 验证密钥登记，rakita 提交 EIP-8358 账户变更净 gas 计量。EIP-8347 PBT 离线状态迁移合并为 Draft。Ethereal news #33 发布。

items.title: EIP-7819：为委托标识加入尾随数据
items.note: （shemnon）提交，新增示例：把 ML-DSA 公钥存放在委托标识的尾随数据中，并用 EIP-8141 代码接受它。
items.title_en: EIP-7819: add trailing data to the delegation designator
items.note_en: (shemnon), submitted, with a worked example storing ML-DSA public keys in the designator's trailing data and EIP-8141 code that accepts them.

items.title: 新 EIP：ML-DSA 验证预编译
items.note: （shemnon）提交，即 EIP-8355，按 FIPS 原文为全部参数集提供预编译。论坛 07:55：三个预编译分别验证 NIST 安全级别 II、III、V（ML-DSA-44、65、87），与 EIP-8051 有重叠，作者列出四处具体分歧，若 8051 解决这些分歧，他更愿意并入 8051。EIP-8081：提议纳入 EIP-8355 提交。
items.title_en: New EIP: Precompiles for ML-DSA Verification
items.note_en: (shemnon), submitted as EIP-8355, a "just the FIPS" set of precompiles for all parameter sets. Forum, 07:55: three precompiles verify NIST security levels II, III and V (ML-DSA-44, 65 and 87); it overlaps with EIP-8051, the author lists four specific disagreements, and he would rather fold it into 8051 if those are resolved. EIP-8081: propose EIP-8355 for inclusion, submitted.

items.title: 新 EIP：账户变更的净 gas 计量
items.note: （rakita）提交，即 EIP-8358：带 value 的调用对交易中首次改变余额的账户收费，之后再改同一账户更便宜，恢复原余额且 nonce 不变可获退款。按 EIP-8038 的 `ACCOUNT_WRITE = 9000`，调用基础费 4000，每个干净账户加 2500；2300 gas stipend 变为被调用方 gas 的下限。已应用的 EIP-7702 授权会改变授权方 nonce，因此之后的调用视该账户为已变更。
items.title_en: New EIP: Net Gas Metering for Account Changes
items.note_en: (rakita), submitted as EIP-8358: a value-bearing call pays for each account whose balance changes for the first time in a transaction, later changes to that account cost less, and restoring the original balance earns a refund if the nonce is unchanged. With EIP-8038's `ACCOUNT_WRITE = 9000`, a call pays a 4000 base plus 2500 per clean account changed; the 2300 gas stipend becomes a floor on callee gas. An applied EIP-7702 authorization changes the authority's nonce, so later calls treat that account as changed.

items.title: EIP-8038：访问列表成本由冷访问成本推导
items.note: （misilva73）提交并合并：两项访问列表成本原为 3000，等于冷访问成本，加上触及时的 `WARM_ACCESS` 共 3100，反而比不用访问列表贵，颠倒了 EIP-2930 的折扣；现均改为 2900。
items.title_en: EIP-8038: derive access list costs from cold access costs
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted and merged: both access list costs were 3000, equal to the cold costs, and since a prepaid entry still pays `WARM_ACCESS` when touched, using an access list cost 3100 versus 3000 without one, inverting the EIP-2930 discount; both are now 2900.

items.title: 新 EIP：EVM 验证密钥登记
items.note: （donnoh）提交，即 EIP-8357：固定地址的系统合约公开每个 L1 分叉批准的 EVM 验证密钥哈希及其接受的无状态输入 `schema_id`（EIP-8025），原生 rollup 可自动跟随当前哈希或固定某个已登记哈希。论坛 21:14。
items.title_en: New EIP: EVM Verification Key Registry
items.note_en: (donnoh), submitted as EIP-8357: a fixed-address system contract exposes fork-approved EVM verification key hashes and the stateless input `schema_id` (EIP-8025) each accepts, so native rollups can follow the current hash automatically or pin a registered one. Forum, 21:14.

summary_en: shemnon submitted two post-quantum-related EIPs: EIP-7819 allows trailing data after the delegation designator, with a worked example storing ML-DSA public keys there and accepting them with EIP-8141 code, and the new EIP-8355 provides verification precompiles for FIPS 204 ML-DSA at three security levels. donnoh submitted EIP-8357, an EVM verification key registry, and rakita submitted EIP-8358, net gas metering for account changes. EIP-8347 offline state migration to the PBT merged as a Draft. Ethereal news #33 was published.
